entries.title: Psalms 62:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. After Jeduthun. A Psalm. Of David.> My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 62:2
segments: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:3
segments: How long will you go on designing evil against a man? running against him as against a broken wall, which is on the point of falling?

entries.title: Psalms 62:4
segments: Their only thought is to put him down from his place of honour; their delight is in deceit: blessing is in their mouths but cursing in their hearts. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 62:5
segments: My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my hope.

entries.title: Psalms 62:6
segments: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:7
segments: In God is my salvation, and my glory; the Rock of my strength, and my safe place.

entries.title: Psalms 62:8
segments: ¶Have faith in him at all times, you people; let your hearts go flowing out before him: God is our safe place. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 62:9
segments: Truly men of low birth are nothing, and men of high position are not what they seem; if they are put in the scales together they are less than a breath.

entries.title: Psalms 62:10
segments: Have no faith in the rewards of evil-doing, or in profits wrongly made: if your wealth is increased, do not put your hopes on it.

entries.title: Psalms 62:11
segments: Once has God said, twice has it come to my ears, that power is God's:

entries.title: Psalms 62:12
segments: And mercy, O Lord, is yours, for you give to every man the reward of his work.
